title: 48 - Operation
summary: At [[location:vulcan]], [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]]'s cancer surgery runs long because the tumour has spread further than expected. [[character:howard]] frets from afar, texting [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]], who has blocked his voice calls, and learns from [[technology:guppi-interface|Guppy]] that [[character:bill]] is busy running [[technology:bullwinkle]]. When the doctors call the outlook positive, Howard breaks down; cancer is curable if caught early, but surgery is still often the only real treatment, and he resolves to look into it. Dialled in on the room phone as Bridget wakes, he sees how close she and Stéphane have become, realises he is an outsider to human life, emails Bill to hurry up with the androids, and vents in his [[technology:vr]].
